name: 45424 · Huber Heights, OH
findings: ZIP 45424 (Huber Heights) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45424 (Huber Heights) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45424 (Huber Heights) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
